name: agent-codespaces-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-codespaces and assert its DEGRADE-SAFE contract -- it shells the agent-worktrees binstub at every AW touch point (account map, L2 leases, worktree claims, --project, state-root) and falls open to ambient behavior when AW is absent, so installed alone it must still provision, expose a binstub with a real version, and answer its read verbs (list/status/leases/validate) rather than hard-fail. Distinct from the downstream Tier-E CAPABILITY eval of the same name (the 6-step CodeSpace workflow, judged). Name-free / public.

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
DEGRADE-SAFE: read verbs fall open without an agent-worktrees base
